[[en]], >>>在上海这座繁华的都市里，不仅汇聚了世界各地的潮流文化，更隐藏着无数让人垂涎欲滴的地道土特产。今天，就让我们一起揭开上海土特产的神秘面纱，看看排行榜前十名中，哪些是你早已熟知，哪些又让你耳目一新？<<<

In the bustling metropolis of Shanghai, not only is it a hub of global culture and trends, but it also hides countless mouthwatering local specialties. Today, let’s uncover the mystery of Shanghai’s local delicacies and explore the top ten ranked items—some you might already know, while others may surprise you.

[[en]], >>>走进上海城隍庙，除了古色古香的建筑，最吸引人的莫过于那满街飘香的五香豆。这些小豆子，外表油光发亮，内里软糯香甜，每一口都充满了浓郁的豆香和独特的五香味道。为何城隍庙五香豆能如此深入人心？或许，正是那份融合了上海老城厢风情的独特韵味，让人难以忘怀。你尝试过用五香豆搭配一杯热腾腾的绿茶吗？评论区告诉我你的独特吃法吧！<<<

When you step into Shanghai’s Chenghuang Temple, beyond the ancient and charming architecture, the most captivating attraction is the alluring aroma of five-spice beans filling the streets. These glossy, flavorful beans are soft and sweet on the inside, each bite bursting with a rich bean fragrance and unique five-spice taste. Why have Chenghuang Temple five-spice beans captured the hearts of so many? Perhaps it’s their distinctive blend of old Shanghai charm and flavors that make them unforgettable. Have you ever tried pairing five-spice beans with a steaming cup of green tea? Share your unique way of enjoying them in the comments!

[[en]], >>>提及上海土特产，怎能不提大白兔奶糖？这颗包裹着白色糖纸的糖果，是多少人童年的甜蜜记忆。轻轻咬开，浓郁的奶香瞬间在口腔中绽放，仿佛回到了那个无忧无虑的童年时光。如今，大白兔奶糖不仅在国内广受欢迎，更是成为了海外华人的心头好。你是否还记得第一次吃到大白兔奶糖的情景？在评论区分享你的甜蜜故事吧！<<<

When it comes to Shanghai specialties, how can we not mention White Rabbit candy? Wrapped in its signature white paper, this iconic treat holds a special place in the childhood memories of many. One bite, and the rich, creamy milk flavor instantly fills your mouth, taking you back to carefree days. Today, White Rabbit candy is not only a beloved treat across China but also a favorite among overseas Chinese communities. Do you remember the first time you tasted White Rabbit candy? Share your sweet stories in the comments!

[[en]], >>>上海梨膏糖，作为一道历史悠久的传统糖果，不仅口感独特，更有着润肺止咳的神奇功效。它以梨汁为主要原料，经过精心熬制而成，色泽金黄，质地酥脆，入口即化。在秋冬季节，来一块梨膏糖，既能享受美味，又能保健养生。你知道梨膏糖的制作过程中有哪些不为人知的秘密吗？评论区等你揭秘！<<<

Shanghai pear syrup candy, a long-standing traditional confection, is not only unique in taste but also known for its soothing effects on the throat. Made from pear juice through meticulous preparation, it boasts a golden hue, crisp texture, and melt-in-your-mouth goodness. In the autumn and winter months, a piece of pear syrup candy offers both delicious enjoyment and health benefits. Do you know any hidden secrets about the making of pear syrup candy? Share your discoveries in the comments below!
